name: integration-next-auth
title: NextAuth (Auth.js) Integration
description: NextAuth v5 events hook that emits amplio auth events (uses local message types — no next-auth type imports needed).
docs: Wire into your NextAuth config: `events: amplioNextAuthEvents()` (create-t3-app: src/server/auth/config.ts), and wrap src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts with withAmplio so rows share the request spine's request_id (`amplio init --wire` does this). After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.
